checks_in_order: Authorization is 'Bearer <ascii token>' (<= 12000 chars) with exactly 3 base64url segments
JOSE header alg == RS256 and kid present
RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SHA-256 signature (stdlib rs256.py: integer pow, EMSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256 DigestInfo, hmac.compare_digest)
claims: iss == issuer; token_use == access; client_id == client_id; exp > now - leeway; iat <= now + leeway; nbf (if present) <= now + leeway; sub non-empty string

fakes.StaticJwksSource: fixed synthetic RSA-2048 test key in tests/rsa_test_key.py; tests sign with pow(m, d, n)

jwks_source.unknown_kid_refresh: once, at most once per 60 s

known_limits: no online revocation check; tokens honoured until exp
organisation membership not in the token; merchant and seller roles come from WFB
backend.mapping: RequestIdentityFacts(verified) implements IdentityFacts -> IdentityFact(CURRENT, ActorContext(user_id, application_id))
backend.verifier: CentralJwtIdentityVerifier(issuer, client_id, application_id, jwks: JwksSource, clock, leeway_s=60)

catalogue_rule: each web app's CATALOGUE service tuple is exactly its own API name (Q01)
producer: wisestay-user-management-backend (IDM-01 registrations); backend adapters in HSB, OSB, HCB, WFB
